## Problem and change

Explain the learner-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

List checks actually run and any concrete limits.

## Review notes

- Lesson content, answer keys and source/licence changes:
- Persistence/schema/content-version migration:
- Docker, backups or environment-variable changes:

Use a Conventional Commit PR title for squash merging. Do not include learner data, secrets or generated test reports.
